{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of customer_segment and customer_age across channels
# to assess comparability
comparability_check = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'], margins=True)

# Check the distribution of customer_age across channels
customer_age_stats = sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].describe()

# Output the results
comparability_check, customer_age_stats"}
